summary.headline: Astrological Questions on Theft
summary.text: Catalog entries 149–165 on astrological methods for building, theft, the thief’s appearance, body marks, kinship, knowledge, whereabouts, source and quantity of stolen objects, and routes of departure, with cross-references to cod. 7 and cod. Flor. 11 and a citation of Apomasar.
